DateJuly 5 — 1939
The Sewell Saddle — Built to Order, 1939

On the fifth of July, 1939, M. E. Sewell of Lucile, Idaho sent twenty-five dollars and this order to the Ray Holes Saddle Co. of Cottonwood — a 1221 Roper built to his own measure: fourteen-and-a-half-inch seat, heavy fork, full stamped, his initials struck into the back of the cantle. Ninety dollars, one-fourth cash with order, balance on delivery. The saddle came home. It never left the family.
